layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: a single item sprite shown whole and centred on a transparent background, a slight three-quarter angle looking a little down, filling most of the square with a small margin, nothing cropped.

Class: one bold chunky item sprite of a single small thing for a turn-based strategy game map, with a big simple silhouette, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes and flat solid colours with one shadow tone, very few details; it must read at a glance at 40 pixels. The item floats alone on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn behind or under it. It belongs to no faction and has no team colour.

layers.text: Subject: two crooked weathered pale grey headstones with rounded tops leaning apart, and one short broken black iron fence bar with a spiked tip in front of them; a little dull moss on the stones; the headstones are the only thing in the image.
The headstones are pale grey stone #b8b4a8 with a darker grey shadow tone #7c786e, not purple; nothing is drawn under them: no ground, no soil, no grass and no glow.
